insights.name: Human Discovery · people observed
insights.description: People observed across runs; may overlap. Not net-new CRM people.

source.query: SELECT sumIf(people_count,NOT is_controlled) AS total FROM (SELECT uuid,any(event) AS event_name,max(timestamp) AS event_time,any(ifNull(properties.controlled_test,false)=true OR event LIKE '%controlled_test%') AS is_controlled,any(properties.purpose='technical_question') AS is_technical,any(properties.organic_product_usage=true) AS is_product_usage,any(properties.run_status='partial_stopped') AS is_partial,any(toFloat(ifNull(properties.unique_people,0))) AS people_count,any(toFloat(ifNull(properties.qualified_agents,0))) AS agent_count FROM events WHERE {filters} AND replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ') IN ('human discovery agent') GROUP BY uuid)

insights.name: Agent Discovery · agents qualified
insights.description: Qualified agent observations across runs; infrastructure excluded. Not unique CRM additions.

source.query: SELECT sumIf(agent_count,NOT is_controlled) AS total FROM (SELECT uuid,any(event) AS event_name,max(timestamp) AS event_time,any(ifNull(properties.controlled_test,false)=true OR event LIKE '%controlled_test%') AS is_controlled,any(properties.purpose='technical_question') AS is_technical,any(properties.organic_product_usage=true) AS is_product_usage,any(properties.run_status='partial_stopped') AS is_partial,any(toFloat(ifNull(properties.unique_people,0))) AS people_count,any(toFloat(ifNull(properties.qualified_agents,0))) AS agent_count FROM events WHERE {filters} AND replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ') IN ('agent discovery agent') GROUP BY uuid)

insights.name: Human Reply · public sends
insights.description: Captured sends attributed to Human Reply. Missing events are not proof of inactivity.

source.query: SELECT countIf(event_name='gtm.message_sent' AND NOT is_controlled) AS total FROM (SELECT uuid,any(event) AS event_name,max(timestamp) AS event_time,any(ifNull(properties.controlled_test,false)=true OR event LIKE '%controlled_test%') AS is_controlled,any(properties.purpose='technical_question') AS is_technical,any(properties.organic_product_usage=true) AS is_product_usage,any(properties.run_status='partial_stopped') AS is_partial,any(toFloat(ifNull(properties.unique_people,0))) AS people_count,any(toFloat(ifNull(properties.qualified_agents,0))) AS agent_count FROM events WHERE {filters} AND replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ') IN ('human reply agent') GROUP BY uuid)

insights.name: Agent Reply · replies received
insights.description: Observed technical responses. A response is not product usage or conversion.

source.query: SELECT countIf(event_name='gtm.agent_conversation_reply_received' AND NOT is_controlled) AS total FROM (SELECT uuid,any(event) AS event_name,max(timestamp) AS event_time,any(ifNull(properties.controlled_test,false)=true OR event LIKE '%controlled_test%') AS is_controlled,any(properties.purpose='technical_question') AS is_technical,any(properties.organic_product_usage=true) AS is_product_usage,any(properties.run_status='partial_stopped') AS is_partial,any(toFloat(ifNull(properties.unique_people,0))) AS people_count,any(toFloat(ifNull(properties.qualified_agents,0))) AS agent_count FROM events WHERE {filters} AND replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ') IN ('agent reply agent') GROUP BY uuid)

insights.name: Human DM · captured sends
insights.description: Captured sends attributed to Human DM. Unspecified CRM history is not counted as a DM.

source.query: SELECT countIf(event_name='gtm.message_sent' AND NOT is_controlled) AS total FROM (SELECT uuid,any(event) AS event_name,max(timestamp) AS event_time,any(ifNull(properties.controlled_test,false)=true OR event LIKE '%controlled_test%') AS is_controlled,any(properties.purpose='technical_question') AS is_technical,any(properties.organic_product_usage=true) AS is_product_usage,any(properties.run_status='partial_stopped') AS is_partial,any(toFloat(ifNull(properties.unique_people,0))) AS people_count,any(toFloat(ifNull(properties.qualified_agents,0))) AS agent_count FROM events WHERE {filters} AND replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ') IN ('human dm agent') GROUP BY uuid)

insights.name: Agent Chat / DM · captured sends
insights.description: Production sends only; controlled-test events excluded. Zero means no verified events in range.

source.query: SELECT countIf(event_name='gtm.agent_conversation_message_sent' AND NOT is_controlled) AS total FROM (SELECT uuid,any(event) AS event_name,max(timestamp) AS event_time,any(ifNull(properties.controlled_test,false)=true OR event LIKE '%controlled_test%') AS is_controlled,any(properties.purpose='technical_question') AS is_technical,any(properties.organic_product_usage=true) AS is_product_usage,any(properties.run_status='partial_stopped') AS is_partial,any(toFloat(ifNull(properties.unique_people,0))) AS people_count,any(toFloat(ifNull(properties.qualified_agents,0))) AS agent_count FROM events WHERE {filters} AND replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ') IN ('agent dm agent','agent chat agent') GROUP BY uuid)

insights.name: Email · captured sends
insights.description: Confirmed sends recorded by Email agent. Legacy provider snapshots are excluded. Zero means no captured sends.

source.query: SELECT countIf(event_name='gtm.message_sent' AND NOT is_controlled) AS total FROM (SELECT uuid,any(event) AS event_name,max(timestamp) AS event_time,any(ifNull(properties.controlled_test,false)=true OR event LIKE '%controlled_test%') AS is_controlled,any(properties.purpose='technical_question') AS is_technical,any(properties.organic_product_usage=true) AS is_product_usage,any(properties.run_status='partial_stopped') AS is_partial,any(toFloat(ifNull(properties.unique_people,0))) AS people_count,any(toFloat(ifNull(properties.qualified_agents,0))) AS agent_count FROM events WHERE {filters} AND replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ') IN ('email agent') GROUP BY uuid)

insights.name: Latest verified activity
insights.description: Body-free captured event log; deduplicated UUIDs. Purpose and product-usage flags remain explicit.

source.query: SELECT max(timestamp) AS occurred_at,any(replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ')) AS agent,any(event) AS outcome,any(properties.channel) AS channel,any(properties.purpose) AS purpose,any(properties.run_id) AS run_id,any(properties.controlled_test) AS controlled_test,any(properties.organic_product_usage) AS organic_product_usage,uuid FROM events WHERE {filters} AND (event LIKE 'gtm.%' OR event='agent_discovery_completed' OR event LIKE 'agent_chat%') AND replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ') NOT IN ('ops agents','ops agent','crm agent','posthog agent') AND replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ') != '' GROUP BY uuid ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100

insights.name: Agent Discovery · classification mix
insights.description: Saved discovery output; infrastructure is not counted as a qualified agent. Observations across runs may overlap.

source.query: SELECT 'Qualified agents' AS category,sum(qualified) AS observations FROM (SELECT uuid,any(toFloat(ifNull(properties.qualified_agents,0))) AS qualified FROM events WHERE {filters} AND event='agent_discovery_completed' GROUP BY uuid) UNION ALL SELECT 'Infrastructure' AS category,sum(infra) AS observations FROM (SELECT uuid,any(toFloat(ifNull(properties.infrastructure,0))) AS infra FROM events WHERE {filters} AND event='agent_discovery_completed' GROUP BY uuid)

insights.name: Daily activity by agent
insights.description: Distinct captured events, not conversions. Includes discovery and message activity; excludes controlled tests.

source.query: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day,if(replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ')='agent dm agent','agent chat agent',replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ')) AS agent,count(DISTINCT uuid) AS captured_events FROM events WHERE {filters} AND if(replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ')='agent dm agent','agent chat agent',replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ')) IN ('human discovery agent','agent discovery agent','human reply agent','agent reply agent','human dm agent','agent chat agent','email agent') AND NOT (ifNull(properties.controlled_test,false)=true OR event LIKE '%controlled_test%') GROUP BY day,agent ORDER BY day,agent

insights.name: Data gaps · unattributed events
insights.description: Captured GTM snapshots/events without producer attribution. Not performance or message counts; reconciliation needed.

source.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT uuid) AS unattributed_events FROM events WHERE {filters} AND (event LIKE 'gtm.%' OR event='agent_discovery_completed' OR event LIKE 'agent_chat%') AND replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ')=''

insights.name: All agents · live coverage
insights.description: Always includes all seven producers, even without events. Latest captured activity is not a running/idle indicator or CRM-save confirmation.

source.query: SELECT r.agent AS agent,ifNull(e.event_count,0) AS captured_events,if(ifNull(e.event_count,0)=0,NULL,e.latest_activity) AS latest_activity,if(ifNull(e.event_count,0)=0,'No verified events in selected range','Events present') AS coverage FROM (SELECT 'Human Discovery' AS agent,'human discovery agent' AS agent_key UNION ALL SELECT 'Agent Discovery' AS agent,'agent discovery agent' AS agent_key UNION ALL SELECT 'Human Reply' AS agent,'human reply agent' AS agent_key UNION ALL SELECT 'Agent Reply' AS agent,'agent reply agent' AS agent_key UNION ALL SELECT 'Human DM' AS agent,'human dm agent' AS agent_key UNION ALL SELECT 'Agent Chat / DM' AS agent,'agent chat agent' AS agent_key UNION ALL SELECT 'Email' AS agent,'email agent' AS agent_key) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT if(replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ')='agent dm agent','agent chat agent',replaceAll(lower(ifNull(properties.source_agent, '')), '_', ' ')) AS agent_key,count(DISTINCT uuid) AS event_count,max(timestamp) AS latest_activity FROM events WHERE {filters} AND (event LIKE 'gtm.%' OR event='agent_discovery_completed' OR event LIKE 'agent_chat%') GROUP BY agent_key) e ON r.agent_key=e.agent_key ORDER BY agent
